opening_question: Namaste. Khaansi ya zukaam ke baare mein bataiye — kab se hai?

mandatory_slots.question: Khaansi sookhi (dry) hai ya balgam ke saath (phlegm) aati hai?
Agar balgam aata hai to uska rang kaisa hai — saaf, peela, ya hara?

screening_questions.question: Gale mein kharaash ya dard hai?
Saans lene mein takleef ya seeti jaisi awaaz aati hai?
Khaansi ke saath seene mein dard hota hai?
Khaansi mein kabhi khoon aaya hai?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi asthma, TB, ya lung ki koi bimari hui hai?
Aap tambaku ya cigarette lete hain?
